title: Senior Principal Presales Sol Architect - Hybrid Cloud
description:
**What success looks like in this role:**

We are seeking a Principal Presales Solution Architect to lead the design and sales strategy for enterprise hybrid cloud managed services. This role combines deep technical architecture with commercial acumen, cost modeling expertise, and hands\-on proficiency with Gen AI tools. You will design end\-to\-end solutions integrating on\-premises datacenters with public cloud platforms (Azure/AWS), author compelling technical proposals, build financial business cases, and influence enterprise deals worth $5–$20M\+. You'll partner closely with sales, delivery, and executive leadership to win transformational opportunities and establish the foundation for successful delivery.


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Solution Architecture \& Design**

* Lead enterprise discovery and requirements\-gathering sessions to understand hybrid cloud infrastructure, operational challenges, and strategic objectives
* Design comprehensive hybrid cloud managed services solutions spanning datacenter operations, infrastructure management (compute, storage, network, security), cloud migration, workload modernization, and operational transformation
* Develop detailed solution architecture documents, technical roadmaps, and implementation playbooks that align with customer maturity levels, budgets, and timelines
* Present solutions to CXO\-level and technical audiences, translating technical capabilities into quantifiable business outcomes (cost savings, operational efficiency, risk reduction, time\-to\-value)

**Cost Modeling \& Financial Analysis**

* Develop detailed cost models and ROI analyses for hybrid cloud solutions, including infrastructure, migration, operational, licensing, and transformation costs
* Build bottom\-up cost estimates from workload assessments, capacity planning, and service delivery models
* Create financial scenarios and sensitivity analyses demonstrating value across different investment horizons and business contexts
* Use cost modeling as a consultative tool to influence solution scope, platform selection, and service delivery approach
* Validate cost assumptions with delivery and finance teams to ensure proposals are realistic, defensible, and profitable post\-signature

**Technical Proposal Development**

* Develop executive summaries, solution architecture diagrams, implementation timelines, resource plans, risk mitigation strategies, and success metrics
* Articulate how our integrated delivery model, service maturity, and methodologies address customer technical and operational requirements
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders (delivery, engineering, security, finance) to validate assumptions and ensure delivery feasibility
* Use Gen AI tools (e.g. Microsoft Copilot) daily to accelerate documentation, refine technical language, synthesize complex requirements, and improve proposal quality and turnaround time
* Leverage AI\-assisted analysis to generate comparative assessments, identify solution gaps, and build persuasive narratives

**Delivery Partnership \& Post\-Sales Success**

* Partner with delivery leadership to ensure presales solutions are feasible, cost\-effective, and aligned with our integrated delivery model and service playbook
* Author transition documents, delivery roadmaps, and transformation playbooks that guide delivery teams and set customer expectations
* Participate in solution kickoffs and steering meetings to ensure alignment between promised outcomes and execution
* Gather post\-engagement feedback to refine solution approaches, cost models, and service maturity

\#LI\-SS1


**You will be successful in this role if you have:**

**Experience*** 8–12 years in IT architecture, systems integration, or presales solutions roles
* Minimum 5 years focused on hybrid cloud, infrastructure modernization, or managed services
* Demonstrated track record of winning enterprise deals or leading complex solution designs that influenced outcomes
* Proven expertise developing cost models, financial analyses, and ROI scenarios for infrastructure and cloud solutions
* Track record authoring technical RFP responses and proposals that have directly influenced deal wins or negotiations
* Experience designing or delivering integrated IT service models spanning infrastructure, cloud, applications, and operations

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep knowledge of hybrid cloud platforms: Azure (preferred) and/or AWS, including IaaS, PaaS, governance, and cost management
* Strong understanding of datacenter operations, infrastructure as code (IaC), automation, and modern operational practices (AIOps, observability)
* Hands\-on familiarity with infrastructure: virtualization, storage, networking, security, disaster recovery in on\-premises and cloud environments
* Experience with migration methodologies (6R framework), workload assessment, and modernization strategies
* Proficient use of Gen AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot) in daily architecture and proposal work as integrated productivity tools, not novelties
* Demonstrated ability to use AI tools for solution design iterations, requirement synthesis, proposal acceleration, and analysis

**Business \& Soft Skills**

* Exceptional communication and presentation skills; ability to translate complex technical concepts for C\-level executives and diverse stakeholders
* Strong consultative and discovery capabilities; ability to identify and quantify hidden customer pain points
* Results\-oriented; ability to manage multiple concurrent opportunities and prioritize for maximum impact
* Collaborative; comfortable influencing outcomes across sales, delivery, marketing, finance, and executive teams
* Strategic thinking; ability to align solutions to organizational transformation goals and business context
* Financial acumen and comfort with cost modeling, margin analysis, and understanding solution design's impact on profitability

**Certifications \& Nice\-to\-Haves**

* Cloud certifications: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Solutions Architect Professional, or equivalent
* ITIL, COBIT, or service management frameworks
* Experience in GTM strategy, services pricing models, or business development
* Familiarity with capability maturity models (CMM, CMMI) or service delivery frameworks
* Prior experience at MSP or system integrator
* Experience with cost modeling tools (Excel, Planful, ServiceNow, or similar)
* Published thought leadership or speaking on hybrid cloud strategy or Gen AI in architecture

title: Presales Head / Manager – Service and Solutions – Apple
description:
**Description**  



  

  

**Company Overview:**


When it comes to IT solution providers, there are a lot of choices. But when it comes to providers with innovative and differentiating end\-to\-end service offerings, there’s really only one: Zones – First Choice for IT.TM


Zones is a Global Solution Provider of end\-to\-end IT solutions with an unmatched supply chain. Positioned to be the IT partner you need, Zones, a Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) in business for over 35 years, specializes in Digital Workplace, Cloud \& Data Center, Networking, Security, and Managed/Professional/Staffing services. Operating in more than 120 countries, leveraging a robust portfolio, and utilizing the highest certification levels from key partners, including Microsoft, Apple, Cisco, Lenovo, Adobe, and more, Zones has mastered the science of building digital infrastructures that change the way business does business ensuring whatever they need, they can Consider IT Done. Follow Zones, LLC on Twitter @Zones, and LinkedIn and Facebook.

**Position Overview:**


As the Presales Head / Manager – Service and Solutions for the Apple, you will own the end\-to\-end presales strategy and the service/solutions charter for Apple offerings across the organization's customer base. You will lead a team of solutions architects and presales consultants, drive win strategies for large and complex Apple Professional and Managed Services opportunities, and ensure that solutions committed during the sales cycle are translated into well\-governed, profitable service delivery.


This is a business\-leadership role that blends presales ownership, solution design governance, Apple partner/vendor management, and oversight of the practice's service and solutions portfolio.


You will act as the primary technical and commercial escalation point for Apple\-related opportunities, represent the practice with Apple and other OEM/ISV partners, and be accountable for the practice's growth, profitability, and delivery quality metrics.

**What you’ll do as the Presales Head / Manager – Service and Solutions, Apple:**

*The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions*

* Own and lead the presales function for the Apple Practice, including RFP/RFI response strategy, solutioning, and deal governance for Professional and Managed Services opportunities.
* Build and lead a team of Apple Solutions Architects and Presales consultants; set priorities, review solutions, and mentor the team on technical and consultative selling skills.
* Define win themes, differentiated value propositions, and competitive pricing strategies for Apple services deals in partnership with sales leadership.
* Present and defend technical and commercial solutions directly to enterprise customers, procurement teams, and CXO\-level stakeholders.
* Drive proactive solution development – evaluation services, assessment services, professional services, and managed services offerings for Apple device lifecycle management.
* Own the accuracy, quality, and timeliness of all technical proposals, SoWs, effort estimation, and pricing models submitted to customers.
* Own the Apple Practice's solutions and service delivery framework, including standard offerings, delivery playbooks, and best\-practice documentation (SoPs, design documents, RACI, rollout approach, technical architectures).
* Ensure smooth transition of won deals from presales to delivery, including handover documentation, staffing plans, and governance cadence.
* Oversee lab setup and management (Apple Business Manager, Jamf, and other MDM platforms) used for solutioning, PoCs, and customer demonstrations.
* Govern service quality, SLAs, and customer satisfaction across managed services engagements; act as escalation owner for critical delivery issues.
* Lead services transition \& transformation projects, including migration of Apple services from one MDM platform to another.
* Drive continuous improvement of solution accelerators, automation, and tooling to improve delivery efficiency and margins.
* Serve as the primary point of contact with Apple's regional teams for joint go\-to\-market planning, enablement, and escalations.
* Maintain and grow relationships with Apple, JAMF, Scalefusion and other MDM/ISV partners to stay ahead of roadmap changes, licensing models, and co\-sell opportunities.
* Represent the practice in partner reviews, QBRs, and industry forums to strengthen the organization's positioning as a strategic Apple partner.

**What you will bring to the team:**

* Proven experience leading a presales, solutions, or services function within an Apple / device management practice.
* Deep understanding of Apple OS platforms (macOS, iOS, iPadOS) and associated hardware/configuration requirements.
* Hands\-on background with Apple Business Manager, JAMF, Scalefusion and other MDM tools (Microsoft Intune, Workspace ONE UEM, etc.).
* Strong knowledge of Apple auto\-enrollment, ABM, Enterprise security, zero\-touch provisioning, and APNS connectivity requirements.
* Experience designing and pricing Professional Services offerings, including effort estimation and commercial modeling.
* Experience managing partner relationships with Apple or other major OEM/ISV vendors.
* Track record of building and leading high\-performing presales or solutions teams.
* 7–10 years of overall experience, with significant time spent leading Apple\-focused presales, solutions, or services functions.
* Strong business acumen with experience owning revenue, margin, and growth targets for a practice or business unit.
* Proven leadership skills with the ability to build, mentor, and scale technical teams.
* Ability to develop executive\-level relationships with customers and partners, translating business priorities into technical and commercial solutions.
* Passionate about delivering exceptional customer experience across the presales\-to\-delivery lifecycle.
* Ability to engage confidently with enterprise and CXO\-level stakeholders.
* Demonstrated professionalism in customer and partner interactions, including solution defense and escalation management.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, with the ability to identify issues, obstacles, and opportunities and drive effective solutions.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity, taking a methodical approach to structuring best\-fit solutions.
* Commitment to meeting and exceeding individual, team, and practice\-level KPIs.
* Excellent written, verbal, and executive presentation skills.

**Zones offers a comprehensive Benefits package.**  

  

While we’re committed to providing top\-tier solutions, we’re just as committed to supporting our own teams. We offer a competitive compensation package where our team members are rewarded based on their performance and recognized for the value, they bring into our business. Our team members enjoy a variety of comprehensive benefits, including Medical Insurance Coverage, Group Term Life and Personal Accident Cover to handle the uncertainties of life, flexible leave policy to balance their work life.


At Zones, work is more than a job – it's an exciting career immersed in an inventive, collaborative culture. If you’re interested in working on the cutting edge of IT innovation, sales, engineering, operations, administration, and more, Zones is the place for you!  

  

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or pregnancy.

title: Presales Solutions Architect - Applications
description:
**What success looks like in this role:**

We are seeking a highly experienced **Presales Solutions Architect \- Application Managed Services (AMS)** to lead solution design, customer engagements, technical proposals, and commercial modeling for enterprise application support, modernization, and managed services opportunities. This role will serve as a trusted advisor to customers, helping them optimize, modernize, manage, and transform their application landscape while aligning technology investments to business outcomes.


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Solution Architecture \& Design**

* Lead discovery workshops, application assessments, and requirements gathering sessions with business and IT stakeholders.
* Analyze current\-state application portfolios, support models, operational challenges, technical debt, and transformation opportunities.
* Develop target\-state architectures, service delivery models, governance frameworks, transition plans, and operational playbooks.
* Present technical and business solutions to executive leadership, business stakeholders, and technical teams.
* Translate technical capabilities into measurable business outcomes such as cost reduction, improved SLA performance, accelerated release cycles, enhanced user experience, and reduced operational risk.

**Cost Modeling \& Financial Analysis**

* Develop comprehensive pricing models, effort estimations, TCO assessments, and ROI analyses for AMS engagements.
* Build bottom\-up estimates for support, enhancement, modernization, cloud transformation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Conduct profitability, margin, and resource utilization analysis.
* Create financial scenarios that demonstrate business value and savings opportunities.
* Collaborate with finance and delivery teams to validate cost assumptions and ensure commercially viable solutions.

**Technical Proposal Development**

* Lead technical responses for RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, and strategic pursuits.
* Develop executive summaries, solution narratives, service architectures, operating models, transition frameworks, and implementation roadmaps.
* Create application support and delivery governance models, SLA frameworks, KPI scorecards, and reporting structures.
* Partner with delivery, engineering, security, cloud, and consulting teams to ensure solution feasibility and alignment.
* Utilize Gen AI tools (Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate proposal development, requirement synthesis, content creation, and solution documentation.
* Develop persuasive value propositions that differentiate offerings and improve win probability.

**Application Modernization \& Transformation Consulting**

* Assess application portfolios and identify opportunities for modernization, rationalization, re\-platforming, re\-engineering, and cloud migration.
* Recommend transformation strategies using modern architectures, microservices, APIs, cloud\-native technologies, DevSecOps, and automation frameworks.
* Develop application lifecycle management strategies aligned with customer business goals.
* Define modernization roadmaps balancing business priorities, risk, cost, and time\-to\-value.

**Delivery Partnership \& Transition Planning**

* Collaborate with delivery organizations to ensure proposed solutions are executable and scalable.
* Develop transition and knowledge transfer plans for new AMS engagements.
* Support customer solution reviews, governance meetings, and deal transition workshops.
* Participate in solution kickoffs to ensure alignment between sales commitments and delivery execution.
* Continuously refine solution frameworks based on delivery feedback and customer outcomes.

**Practice Development \& Thought Leadership**

* Contribute to AMS solution accelerators, reusable assets, proposal templates, and service offerings.
* Support market intelligence, competitive analysis, and industry\-specific solution development.
* Mentor junior solution architects and presales consultants.
* Stay current with emerging trends in AI\-powered operations, Application Modernization, Cloud\-Native Engineering, DevSecOps, and Digital Transformation.

**Business \& Soft Skills**

* Strong executive presence with ability to engage CXO stakeholders.
* Excellent presentation, storytelling, and workshop facilitation skills.
* Strong consultative selling and customer advisory capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple strategic pursuits simultaneously.
* Exceptional collaboration across sales, delivery, consulting, finance, and leadership teams.
* Strong commercial acumen with understanding of pricing, margins, profitability, and risk management.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value narratives.

**Certifications \& Nice\-to\-Haves**

* Azure Solutions Architect Expert / AWS Solutions Architect Professional
* AI/ML certifications (Azure AI Engineer, AWS ML Specialty, etc.)
* Experience in AI governance, Responsible AI frameworks
* ITIL / Service management frameworks
* Exposure to GTM strategy, pricing models, or business development
* Prior experience in system integrators, consulting firms, or global delivery models

\#LI\-SS1
**You will be successful in this role if you have:**

### **BA/BS degree and 8\+ years’ relevant experience OR equivalent combination of education and experience**
**Master’s degree preferred.**

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

**Experience**

* 10\-15 years of overall IT experience.
* Minimum 5\+ years in Presales, Solution Architecture, Consulting, or Managed Services.
* Experience designing and positioning large\-scale AMS engagements.
* Proven success supporting enterprise pursuits, strategic deals, and RFP responses.
* Strong track record of influencing deal wins through solution consulting and architecture leadership.
* Experience managing multi\-tower engagements across application development, support, modernization, cloud, and operations.
